svg.title: Three concentric-ring layout options for the 14-sensor BRIAN 2.0 array
svg.desc: Three top-down PCB layout options arranging 14 gas sensors and a BME680 in concentric rings around a center point, with a dashed optional chamber boundary.

text.style: fill:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Serif Variable", "Anthropic Serif", ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:auto

g.text: Simplest build. Rails in two arcs (9 + 5).
